column1: This dataset contains information on Method-Specific CPR and Share of Current Modern Method Mix for Implants, Injectables, IUDs, and Pills, Married Women, 2003–2017

Abbreviations: CPR, contraceptive prevalence rate; DHS, Demographic and Health Survey; DRC/K, Democratic Republic of the Congo/Kinshasa only; DMPA, depot medroxyprogesterone acetate; IUD, intrauterine device; mCPR, modern contraceptive prevalence rate; NA, not available; PMA, Performance Monitoring and Accountability 2020; R, round.

Notes: Uppermost entry for each country is latest available DHS survey report or PMA2020 Family Planning Brief as of December 31, 2017. Table ordered according to implant CPR (Column 3). All data reported as percentages.
Sum of the intramuscular DMPA injectable and the subcutaneous injectable Sayana Press.
